offering_description.value: Phoenix Education Partners provides career-focused degree and certificate programs for working adults through the University of Phoenix. It delivers most instruction online and works with employers to connect employees with its programs.

primary_services.value: Undergraduate degree programs; graduate degree programs; certificate programs; professional development courses

customer_segment.value: B2C: Working adults and other students seeking degrees or career credentials; B2B: Employers sponsoring education for their employees

revenue_model.value: service fees: Tuition and course fees paid by students or their sponsors

value_chain_position.value: service provider: Develops curricula and uses faculty to deliver courses and award credentials to adult learners

geography_served.value: US national: Serves students across the United States, primarily online

specialization.value: related lines: Undergraduate and graduate degrees, certificates, and professional development for adult learners

distribution_channels.value: online: University website for applications and an online learning platform for instruction; direct sales: University enrollment advisers who work directly with prospective students; partners / resellers: Employer education benefit programs that connect employees with the university

regulatory_exposure.value: high: State authorization, Higher Learning Commission accreditation, and U.S. Department of Education oversight of federal student aid
